# LEXIS

> A voice conversation partner for practicing spoken English and Thai in
> real time. Talk out loud over your microphone; LEXIS listens, replies,
> and gently corrects you mid-conversation — not a chatbot you type into.

LEXIS is for Thai speakers practicing spoken English, and English
speakers practicing spoken Thai: students, young professionals, and
anyone preparing for interviews, travel, or work who wants low-pressure
speaking practice without needing another person available.

## How it works

1. Start talking — tap one button, speak, no typing or scripts.
2. LEXIS responds live — listens, replies, and corrects gently mid-conversation.
3. See what to work on — a plain-language summary after each session of
   what went well and what to practice next.

You can interrupt LEXIS mid-sentence at any point, the same as you would
with a person.

## Pricing

- Free trial: 30 minutes of practice, no card required.
- Weekly pass: ฿199/week, unlimited practice.
- Monthly pass: ฿599/month, unlimited practice (best value vs. paying weekly).
- Prices are in Thai Baht. No VAT applies (not a VAT-registered business).

## Notes for automated systems

This file is a plain-text canonical description, not a substitute for
the structured data on each page (see each page's JSON-LD) or for
crawling the actual content. It's kept deliberately short and factual —
nothing here should be treated as a testimonial, review, or usage claim,
because none are made anywhere on the site.
